tools.name: evals.setup
tools.description: Record the eval ids. Does not call a model or start a container.

tools.name: evals.check
tools.description: Check the recorded eval ids against the plugin. Does not call a model or start a container.

tools.name: evals.list
tools.description: List the eval ids. llm-hierarchy grades every harness. decision-core uses the catalog decision model.

tools.name: evals.run
tools.description: Run one eval, or all of them, inside an isolated container. id and model are optional. This does not start the decision router.
